verdict.rationale: The README offers both scopes as install options: copy the skill folder into your personal (all projects) skills directory or into the project skills directory, where it can be committed with the repo. A plugin-marketplace install path is also provided. The evidence is a single line, though, and it relies on manual copying. Missing for 10: exact directory paths for each scope, explicit guidance on committing the project-local copy, scope selection for the plugin install, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
